images.caption: Colin Stuart is being surrounded by the Aussies
images.longCaption: West Indian batsman Colin Stuart (2/R) is surrounded by close-in Australian fielders after the West Indies lost three quick wickets late on the third day of the fourth Test Match at the MCG in Melbourne, 28 December 2000. Australia declared their second innings close at 262-5 and at stumps the West Indies are again in deep trouble at 10-3 chasing 462 to win.

images.caption: Colin Stuart, Western Australia v West Indians, 2000/01
images.longCaption: 10 Nov 2000: Colin Stuart for the West Indies in the match between the Western Warriors and the West Indies at the WACA ground in Perth, Australia.

images.caption: Stuart bowling during training
images.longCaption: 5 Nov 2000: Colin Stuart fast bowler for the West Indies about to launch into a delivery, during the team training sesion today at the WACA cricket ground, as the West Indies in prepere for the up coming test series against Australia. WACA, Perth , Australia.

images.caption: Colin Stuart being congratulated by his team as he sent back Ponting
images.longCaption: Colin Stuart (C) of the West Indies is congratulated by team-mates after taking the wicket of Australian Ricky Ponting LBW in the Federation test at the Sydney Cricket ground 04 January. Australia is currently 5-305 with the West Indies making 272 in the first innings.
